A '''restraining container''' was used by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to hold violent [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]]. Two [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|Guardian police droids]] put [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] into one but she managed to escape by tricking the droids into thinking that she could not breathe.
